info.description: Local analysis, nyales-risk-1. Explicit versioned policies, immutable evidence in private R2 and references in D1. Financial amounts are whole IDR rupiah. History is not a persistent access grant. Does not modify customer status, owner, targets, visits, incentives or telesales permissions.

x-rules: Enabled policy rules require all thresholds; no business defaults.
Only one active policy; active config immutable. Activation uses If-Match, hash, expected active ID and explicit confirmation.

GET current does not run the risk engine or write. A bounded regional input scan is still required for freshness/cache validation. POST freezes source/basis and requires unchanged revision and active policy at commit.
Cache binds actor/scope, filters, policy, release and input snapshot; changed input requires new evaluation.
Missing or tampered R2 fails closed; unreferenced upload is removed only after DB proves it is not committed.
All invoice inputs stay inside authorized historical finance scope. Company-wide near-churn history requires organization-wide permission; otherwise unknown.
Retired boundary history is shown as evidence, never silently overlaid on a replacement release.
Received-source completeness and sufficient positive baseline required; absent flag does not mean safe.
